responsibility: This definition module exposes the generated parser entry point for mc pass 3. Its CompilationUnit routine is the driver-visible hook for the stage that fills in imports, declarations, and composite type structure after the earlier skeleton and enum/type-equivalence passes.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is only the exported interface for the generated mcp3 parser pass, providing the CompilationUnit declaration; unlike mcp3.bnf, it does not encode the pass-3 grammar or its declaration-building actions.
